name: UWCSEA Dover
summary: IB continuum campus on Dover Road with a strong service and outdoor education culture.
body: United World College of South East Asia’s Dover campus runs the IB continuum in a west-central location popular with families near Holland V, Clementi, and Bukit Timah. Admissions are selective and mission-aware; the community is intentionally international. Boarding options exist for eligible students.
waitlistNotes: High demand; applications open on published cycles.
